second_annotator_iaa.interpretation: Independently validated on a subset using inter-annotator agreement. Cohen's kappa accounts for chance agreement; exact % alone overstates reliability.

leakage.note: Golden is drawn from held-out test conversations by design; test∩golden overlap is expected and not a leakage failure. Leakage fails only if golden IDs appear in train fitting, retrieval index, or prompt exemplars.
